Пришло время написать полный обзор на игру.
[b] Как обычно стоит разделить обзор на категории, по-этому начну с [/b]

[h2] Геймплей [/h2]

Пожалуй основная составляющая игры и особенность, за которую её так любят. Игра позволяет с нуля построить свою империю по добыче и обработке руды, заняться фермерством с использованием специализированной техники, или заняться рыбалкой. О каждом аспекте по подробнее:

[b] Металлообработка [/b]
Начиная с тазика и щеточки, игра позволяет спланировать и сконструировать производственную линию обработки руды. Используя буры где-то под землёй руду можно поднять на поверхность с помощью конвейеров и складировать ее в чанах для лёгкого использования. В случае необходимости можно вылить пару слитков и на наковальне сделать оружие или драгоценности, которые затем можно продать за монеты или поторговать с жителями за специальные жетоны. Обработка руды начинается с кусочка земли, который проходя через измельчитель преобразуется в одну из множества руд или самоцветов, которые можно автоматизированным методом направить в определённый чан или произвести огранку самоцвета. Игра наполнена уровнями развития: лучшие прииски, улучшение буров и труб, оптимизация и автоматизация процесса. Буры и измельчители имеют свойство периодически ломаться, но этот эффект можно компенсировать фильтрами для воды, которые в свою очередь тоже ломаются. Но и те можно чинить, а если в карманах есть пару лишних тысяч - соорудить автоматическую схему ремонта, которая позволит отойти от игры на пару реальных часов и всё ещё получать прибыль (не рекомендую уходить в афк на слишком долго, об этом подробнее в [u] баги [/u]).

[b] Фермерство [/b]
От данного слова, к сожалению или счастью, осталось только та часть, в которой игроку понадобится посадить семена, регулярно их поливать а затем собрать урожай и сварить вкусный суп, который можно обменять у жителя на специальные жетоны, или продать за монеты. Процесс так-же имеет уровни развития и автоматизации: автоматическая поливка, и нарезка урожая, его распределение по соответствующим лоткам.

[b] Рыбалка [/b]
Про эту ветку развития мне особо сказать нечего. Существует 8 рангов удочек, которые позволяют ловить более редкую рыбу и продавать её. Для улучшения удочки требуется принести необходимую рыбу в Бёрнскрофт, положить в ведёрко у рыболовного мастера и нажать кнопочку. Особого развития или автоматизации тут не предусмотрено.

Вкратце стоит так-же объяснить, почему игра так называется и в чём её главная изюминка. [b] Вода [/b] является неотъемлемой частью игрового процесса и служит неким "энергетическим ресурсом" или топливом. На воде работают конвейеры, буры, транспорт и техника. От давления воды зависит скорость производства и возможность оного на больших дистанциях от источника.

Игра могла бы быстро наскучить, если бы не имела много разных возможностей. О всех я рассказывать не стану, некоторые из них могут стать для Вас сюрпризом. Игра не ведёт игрока за руку, а старается предоставить роль исследователя самому игроку.

[h2] Графика [/h2]
Графика является не самой сильной стороной игры. Не смотря на это, игра придерживается особого низкополигонального стиля, что придаёт ей несомненно необычный вид. Поддерживает DLSS.

[h2] Звуковое сопровождение [/h2]
Красивая авторская музыка (но не имеет больных условий использования), звуки и эмбиент - хорошая совокупность для игры. А для инди-игры и вовсе невероятное достижение. Чего только стоит звук бросания трубы.

[h2] Баланс [/h2]
В этом плане игра превосходит своих конкурентов в разы. Баланс в игре точно отточен до мелочей, игровой процесс является приятным. Никогда нет ощущения, что делаешь что-то не то или что слишком быстро поднимаешься в прогрессе. В игре нет инвентаря и это безусловно плюс - не получится быстро транспортировать предметы из магазина, нужно использовать технику (да и большинство магазинов предусматривает парковку на поле покупки для того, чтобы сразу загружать нужный материал в машину, а затем его оплатить).

[h2] Локализация [/h2]
Локализация сделана на высшем уровне, переведены и разумно адаптированы мелочи и игры слов. Все предметы имеют здравое название и описание, почти все персонажи - реплики (за исключением буквально двух-трех персонажей без реплик, но уверен - это исправят!).

[h2] Баги [/h2]
В этом плане у игры тоже не всё печально. Баги в игре, конечно, есть, но далеко не все из них критичные. Некоторые баги можно исправить обычной перезагрузкой игры или сохранения (без потери прогресса). Критичные баги стараются фиксить сразу (например баг с потерей игровых сохранений, который проявлялся буквально у единиц, умудрились исправить. Не смотря на это, сохранения могут пропасть, но для этого нужно иметь физически поврежденный диск). Конвейеры могут периодически забиваться рудой, но сама руда не имеет столкновений и почти не мешает перемещению другой руды (есть исключение, когда руда "зависает" почти у точки сброса с конвейера, где она может изменять направление других руд).

[h2] Мультиплеер [/h2]
Как такового интернет мультиплеера в игре не предусмотренно в виду особенностей игрового движка. Но в игре присутствует совместная игра по раздельному экрану с поддержкой Steam Remote Play (splitscreen coop). В этом даже есть небольшой плюс: чтобы поиграть вдвоём не обязательно двум игрокам владеть копией игры в стиме, достаточно одному игроку быть "хостом" с игрой на аккаунте, а второму "гостем" без игры. Но из недостатков банальная удобность - постоянно отвлекаешься на не свою часть экрана или звуки, только один игрок может использовать клавиатуру и мышь, остальные могут играть только с контроллером.

[h3] Под-итожим [/h3]
Пускай игра не имеет полноценного функционального мультиплеера, всё ещё имеет несколько неисправимых багов, но многочасовой идеально сбалансированный геймплей, который игра дарит вперемешку с стилизованной графикой и отличным звуковым сопровождением, делает эту игру шедевром в своём жанре, которая с лёгкостью обходит АА конкурентов.
Пускай игроки на метакритике дают игре 6 баллов, я считаю отсутствие инвентаря преимуществом, а не недостатком и могу согласится с самим метакритиком о том, что игра достойна [u]9.5/10[/u]

О внесении грамматических правок пишите снизу. Спасибо, что потратили время на прочтение данного отзыва. Надеюсь, что игра даст Вам гораздо больше!

Things fall over, spill, or roll away. I feel like it's going for a sort of "rage-game lite" feel. I wanted a chill and relaxing mining game, not a game where I have to struggle with the controls to do the most simple and basic tasks. That makes me feel like the game was designed for streamers - so their annoyance can amuse their viewers. 
For example, the tutorial helpfully tells me that a shadow will let me know where an object will fall if I drop it. The problem is, the shadow is a very small dot, and it is invisible if you're standing in shadows, and it's invisible on certain colors or textures. And half the time when you drop the item, it catches the edge of something and falls sideways and doesn't end up where you want it anyway. Why not just have things drop where you're pointing the mouse? Why do you pick up from the center of the screen, but drop from the right of center?
It's like the game is deliberately making itself an annoyance to play.

4/5 stars in my mind.  It is fun and the factory / engineering craft in it is enjoyable and the price is good for what you get.

My issues with the game:
Interface or lack thereof - There is no interface or inventory and you can hold exactly one item at a time making the early game sluggish and boring.  Purchasing items for a large build winds up being an hour of transferring items into a vehicle and the way the shop works you can accidentally easily delete them and have to do it again.

Weight system and physics of items was well intentioned but poorly executed.  The un-optomized physics system means too many small items (unrefined or minimally processed) causes huge lag spikes which would be fine if the system was more consistent but it is not uncommon for items to become stuck and cause clogging issues that result in a huge buildup then forcing you to use the bandaid solution of "Clear all raw resources" deleting potentially a lot of value that you were trying to achieve.  God forbid it is an issue of gems which count as a processed resource and you must manually move them 1 at a time until you get a magnet but even then you often need to pull apart your factory to remove them.

"Logic" system is inconsistent at best.  I am an engineer personally and have noticed lots of small inconsistencies and issues with the logic system.  It's hard to pinpoint exactly where issues pop up, I think it is just underdeveloped still.

Overall I would say other engineering games have been better but this is worth the cost.  If you haven't played Factorio, Satisfactory, Oxygen not included, etc I would play those first

review: Great game
haha drills go brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr

Hydroneer is all mechanics, and very little story, or anything else. Granted, you don't need a narrative reason to go from panning nuggets to core-drilling, but it'd be nice to have one.

You are a dude. A normal dude. You are here to mine, and make money. You will do this until you personally get bored or run out of new content. I don't quite understand what the setting is supposed to be, as you have medieval castles as well as dieselpunky cars.

This game is very invested in the process of "levelling up" equipment and processes. you use tool 1 so you can afford to use tool 2 so you can afford to use tool 3 and so on. This mixed with later automation and increased output ability's really spurs you forward if you're of a mind to make the numbers go up and improve your operation. Which I am.

A thing the game does well is force you to actually adapt and overcome problems if you want to get things done in a reasonable time. You WANT to move from panning to drilling because panning is a pain-in-the-ass time sink. you WANT to improve your automation because moving everything by hand is a pain-in-the-ass fiddly mess. Earlier systems exist and are left behind entirely as you move forward to help you actually FEEL your progress.

A thing the game does poorly is the clunky physics-based item interaction, and the length of enforced tedium. Imagine if Satisfactory or Minecraft forced you to interact with the world with no inventory, and every item was a Gmod/HL physics object. you will quickly become annoyed with how you can't just place things where they need to go 75% of the time. You will be very much over each stage of development long before you can move on. It doesn't add anything to the game, it just annoys me and wastes my time.

I'm not entirely sure why they added farming. This is a mining game, where you mine to get better at mining. That's the premise. The gameplay systems devised for mining and automation work well for the farming side, but I can't help but feel it would have been a better idea to spin it off into its own game (farmoneer, or whatever) and have the two develop their specialisms much better.

A good QoL patch that figures out exactly what it wants to convey with the weird item physics -or removes them entirely- would turn this into an instant recommend, as is I can only say I hope you have a lot of patience for fiddly ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ getting in the way of a good mining game.

review: 游戏还不错，可以玩，但是没有多人游戏

I wish I could give the game a Mixed Review though I would Favorably give it a 65/100.

Hydroneer is an interesting Building/Automation game with a simple gameplay loop where you mine for Ores, Smelt them into Items, and sell for Profit. It's got a good foundation set for Mechanics and Structure, however, the Experience of the Overall Atmosphere and Depth of the Game feels slightly Dull, Cheap, and Empty. While I did enjoy my time with the game here and there, the tedium  of the games engagement is not hard to ignore.

(Pros)

The Automation is nice and Satisfying with being able to see the physical ores running through the conveyor belts as they are being processed and refined. It's especially Satisfying when you have a magnitude of Drills and get to see all that Dirt turn into a huge sum of profit. I do find it annoying needing to attach pipes all over just to get it running, but it's in the name I suppose, water powering everything.

(Cons)

The World feels Empty and Ameraturish, the Terrain feels like someone strung up the Terrain Brush tool and called it a day. 
Towns feel Barren and Primitive as if they were thrown around from a Bundle Asset Pack. 
The NPC's just stand around, sometimes they talk, sometimes they give quests, but overall they don't really make the towns look populated with how far and sparse they are.

The Map Design feels clunky and messy, making navigation more of a Chore then making you feel like a Traveling Salesman.
The Position of the Shops feels awkward and all over, and to find what you're looking for can take a bit of time to figure out.

While having multiple plots sounds neat in Theory, once you have an established system in the deepest plot, say a row of Drills, all the other plots feels obsolete. Why waste time building in each plot when you can build a primary base that's closest to Town?

(Final Thoughts)
Hydroneer has Potential, it has a good set of Systems and Mechanics that could be expanded and refined upon in it's Gameplay Loop. However, at the same time, it struggles to know what to do with it and how to stylize and build the overall theme around itself. Along with making the world interesting to be in.

Gameplay can be Fun, but you will noticed plenty of annoying nitpicks from time to time with not just the Gameplay Loop, but possibly the Atmosphere of it too.

НО есть и минусы которые все портят:
- фишка игры отсутствие инвентаря, но блин сделайте хоть какую-то помощь игроку, например доставку в магазинах, перетаскивать 30 различных секций труб этот тот еще ад, про блоки бетона вообще молчу, 2 на 2 в грузовик практически не лезет, а их минимум 10 нужен что-бы создать какую-то площадку. Здесь я бы добавил дополнительную "платную" функцию в магазине - доставка на участок того что купил.
- дисбаланс, в игре есть жилы (1 кубик с определенной рудой) но по выходу он в два раза меньше чем бур на обычной почве глубиной Т2, смысл этих жил вообще пропадает. Я вообще на этом погорел - потратил 7 часов чтобы их выкопать, соединить все конвейером в общую сеть, а оно того не стоили. Я бы изменил выход с жил так чтобы он превышал или хотя-бы ровнялся Т3 буру на самом дне почвы (22 блока), так как жила в один блок на нее можно поставить только 1 бур - баланс это не поломает. Иначе эта функция в жилами бесполезна.
- строительство, это отдельная боль, чтобы весь процесс автоматизировать нужно много строить, в довесок с доставкой это то еще убийство времени, проблема в штучном переносе и распределении. Я бы добавил отдельный склад на участке добыче где складывались все купленные блоки (я бы добавил функцию автоматического сброса с грузовика) и в ввел новый инструмент "жезл строителя" - у которого была функция радиального меню и он позволял размещать блоки без необходимости их таскать.
- еще я бы ввел блокнот с функцией записи заказов, искать заказчика супа в горах тот еще геморрой: бегаешь с этой миской по горам - ура нашел, оно выпило, кинуло в вас эту миску сказало спасибо, дало монетки и ушло в закат, а тебе надо отнести монетки и еще вернутся за миской. Тут не хватает кошелька на пояс как каску например.

В заключение скажу, игра в целом не плохая, но вот эта рутина носиться с одним предметом туда сюда все убивает, нужна автоматизация всех процессов на поздних этапах игры. То в каком состоянии она сейчас есть - отпугнет большинство игроков.

review:
TL;DR: Fun idea but very tedious, unbalanced, poorly optimized. 

The game is fun for the first 5-10 hours. After that (and a little during the beginning as well) the game becomes tedious, very tedious.
You can only hold one item at the time witch makes buying and cleaning up items a huge tedious chore. The magnet tool can help if you have a big mess though.  
The economy is all over the place and quickly becomes highly unbalanced. The economy becomes even more tedious by having 3 different kinds currency.
Plots of land and vehicles are extremely cheap and gives you little to no motivation to keep earning money/coins.    

 The whole farmer game mechanic is even more out of balance and tedious then all the other game mechanics. One water sprinkler cost over 2000 really? the one thing that could eliminate a huge annoying part of the farming cost as much as combine-harvester. You have to water all the plants that needs water 3-6 times for each crop. So having to deliver a soup with 600 crops is INSANE! 
Why can't i just hold the crop-basket and click on a crop with the basket in hand to fill up the basket. 

The game is highly unoptimized, i am baffled by their decision on having thousands of different items that also have physics, no game-engine can handle that. i kept an eye on my pc performance and my pc was doing fine, yet the game would not respond and completely freeze up when i try to pick up a bucket full of gems, so i am a bit soft locked on that. Also no matter where i am on the map and look at the direction of the bucket full of gems my framerate drops from 144 to 20 even though the game only uses 25% or so, on my graphics-card (rtx 4070 ti super, 32Gb ram, intel i9). 
Recently they "fixed" a bug with corrupted save files by making it possible to load a older save. That is not a "fix" that is a workaround, but it is still better then nothing and i do understand the frustration they must have with this one, since they can't recreate the save bug on purpose.

The game needs a lot of QoL improvement and polish. For example you need to jump in order to put something on a table. Some building objects don't align up properly.  You need 5 water filters (and auto repair) to get 100% clean water. Most of the logic components don't serve any purpose other then being there for the auto repair system that also needs tons of repair tools, just why? A single one is just fine. 
The different metal bars you make only have a different color, that makes it really hard to differentiate them from one another if they are being heated up, making them look the same. This color scheme only thing must be hard for color-blind people. Also the gold-bar and the Cloutium-bar looks a lot alike in color, this have confused a lot of new players when they wanted to make the T2 drills etc. Also the T3 drill etc don't seem to serve much purpose. 
The map is nice but also tedious to drive around in, because a lot of roads are very cramped and have annoying short/low lamppost and signs sticking in to the space of the road.         
   
 The game is good, but at this current state it is way to tedious to enjoy it. Hopefully they will fix/change the game in the future and if they do i will also change/fix my review. 

i wish the best of luck and success for the dev team :)

Интересная игра с ужасной реализацией. Я всегда любил игры подобного жанра и каждый раз испытывал неподдельное удовольствие от геймплея, здесь же это уходит в крайнюю ненависть, так как сама идея хороша и этим интересно заниматься, однако же реализация механик и некоторых аспектов здесь просто ужасная. Первые пять часов я думал, что могу с этим смириться и дальше по ходу развития технологии добычи все проблемы уйдут, но сейчас, когда надо реализовать это самое развитие я стою и пытаюсь вставить этот сраный таз под правильным углом, чтобы всё нормально работало, я пытаюсь собрать магнитом ресурсы и фпс падает до пяти, я тыкаюсь в стену из ошибок и не понимаю, зачем это было реализовано именно таким образом? К этому можно привыкнуть, это можно преодолеть, но каждое действие обозначает дрочность, разработчики видимо очень любят, когда игрок не может сделать те или иные вещи, просто потому что им взбрело в голову сделать каждый кусочек ресурса физичным и при взаимодействии с оными игра напрягается так сильно, что, простите за тавтологию, становится неиграбельной. Разработчики не могут реализовать установку этого идиотского тазика таким же образом, как установку любого оборудования через лкм, это просто бредятина, либо же им реально в кайф делать механики, чтобы задрочить игроков до максимума. Многие игры стремятся к удобности, та же факторио 
 или сатисфактори (и да, я понимаю, что эти две игры - это игры про другое, аналогия чисто из-за возможности автоматизации - не более) имеют кучу инструментов, чтобы игроку было удобно взаимодействовать со всем наполнением игры. Здесь этого нет и не будет, потому что, ну извините, ты должен привыкнуть к кривизне и тогда возможно ты начнёшь получать неподдельное удовольствие, а первые эти твои часы страдай. Да вот только прикол в том, что на этих первых часах и основывается мнение про игру, среднестат игрок просто дропнет неудобный "продукт", потому что он кривой, так и не дойдя до остальных механик, какими бы прекольными они не были - об этом разрабы вряд ли думают. Тащемта, подводя итог, хотите нормально с кайфом сидеть и играть в игрушку про автоматизацию - будьте готовы первые часы проводить в лютой ♥♥♥♥♥.

review:
The short version is, once you get past the initial confusion in what you're actually meant to be doing, you realise you're meant to be grinding.

This game offers no instruction. In fact it offers so little instruction and is so dependent on a wiki that the "B" key is a shortcut to open the object you're looking at in the wiki.

When I first opened this game, I found myself on a road standing next a vehicle I could apparently drive. So I got in the vehicle and drove up the road. Ten minutes of aimlessly wandering and wondering how to use the shops or how to earn money, I gave up and went for lunch.

Next I started a new game and looked at the wiki. The wiki told me that at the start of the game I am now the proud owner of my very own dig site. Okay, I guess I wasn't meant to drive up the road. The wiki says there's a shovel and some stuff in this dig site somewhere. Okay... I don't see it.

I was losing patience at this point but I went searching for an actual tutorial, and AHA, on the main menu there's a tutorial mode. Now we're getting somewhere. Okay I'm meant to pick up a lantern.

It took me 5 minutes to find the lantern in the tutorial.

Eventually after that long, frustrating experience just finding out the basics of what the game is about, I ran through the tutorial and the way it worked seemed kind of cool. You can only ever hold one item at a time, and everything is about physically manipulating objects. You have to use a handcart or a truck to move objects over distance. You have to pick up ores and smelt them in a big pot one at a time. You can physically pick up your money and take it to the shop. Then you start adding automation like drills and you can lay out pans so that ores end up in them and then tip that pan into your furnace and make bars. Okay, the mechanics are pretty novel. I'm interested.

Then the game is hours and hours of just doing that.

So, I refer you back to my first sentence. The game is an initial period of being frustrated by the lack of instruction, with a small high in the middle when you realise the mechanics are kind of cool, and then however many hours you can tolerate of sifting for shiny things in dirt and selling them.

review:
Hydroneer is an absolute gem for anyone who loves immersive, sandbox-style gameplay with a heavy emphasis on exploration, creativity, and progression. From the moment you start, the game invites you into a world where mining, building, and managing resources are the core of the experience, yet it never feels like a grind. Instead, it pulls you into its loop of discovery and improvement, making it hard to put down.

The mechanics are both intuitive and rewarding. The primary objective of mining for resources and refining them into valuable materials is deeply satisfying. As you dig deeper into the earth, you feel a real sense of progression and achievement as you uncover new resources and upgrade your equipment. The game also introduces you to the concept of automation, where you can set up complex mining and processing systems, and watching them work efficiently provides a gratifying sense of control over your expanding empire.

The visuals in Hydroneer are wonderfully relaxing. The world feels rich and alive with vibrant, lush landscapes that contrast nicely with the darker, more industrial areas where your mining operations take place. The environments are detailed, and the physics of the water and mining equipment feel very realistic, adding a layer of immersion that enhances the overall experience.

The sound design is another highlight. The gentle hum of your machines, the splashes of water as it flows through your mining operations, and the rhythmic noise of the drilling create a soothing atmosphere that makes the gameplay experience even more engaging. The soundtrack is subtle but complements the setting perfectly, providing a relaxing backdrop that doesn't distract from the action.

What really sets Hydroneer apart is how it lets you approach the game at your own pace. There's no rush, no time limits—just a constant feeling of growth and accomplishment as you build your mining empire. The challenges are carefully designed to keep you engaged, pushing you to refine your systems and explore new techniques, while still leaving room for creativity.

Whether you're a fan of building games, resource management, or just enjoy an immersive and calm gameplay experience, Hydroneer has something for everyone. It's a delightful, rewarding experience that constantly encourages you to innovate and improve, making it a perfect choice for anyone looking to get lost in a game for hours at a time.

I guess i'll start off by saying that this game is an obvious sandbox game, and the story is a bit light (it doesn't really exist that much).

But this game is fun, if not a bit tedious to start out.  It will take you a couple hours to get the money you need in order to start actually automating stuff, and the "1 item at a time" is a major part of playing the game.  Simple machines will take hours to set up, but once you get a good build set up properly, maintaining it comes down to just dumping in repair kits to the repair apparatus.

Completing the game is basically just finishing all of the steam achievements, which are not impossible feats.

IF you are looking for a game with a story arc, an epic boss battle, and roll credits:  you will be disappointed.

IF you are looking for a game that you can relax, build ridiculous mining setups, become a billionaire with relative ease, and wander around and dig pointlessly, then your dreams will come true with this game.

Pros:
Terraforming is satisfying and necessary
As of the time of me playing this, i had trouble making the game unstable through normal gameplay, they really fixed this game up a lot.
The grind isn't too bad after the first couple hours, with the right setup you can AFK the mining setup almost entirely and work on making guild tokens.

Cons.
Beginning grind is a bit long and painful, but this is also unlikely to be a game you'll put 5000 hours into.
Basically SP only.
Could use a more coherent story/progression system.  It is a single player game after all, and after a while it just seems you run out of things to do that aren't steam achievements and stop playing.

review: Its a good game

自分はドチャクソハマったので親指を立てましたが、正直めちゃめちゃ人を選ぶゲームだと思います。
駄目な人はホント駄目だと思う、でも合う人にはめっちゃ合うので、セール時600円くらいというのは破格すぎる。

かなり硬派な工場建築系で、"手間を楽しむ"の最たる物という印象。

ゲームスタートするとなんの案内もなしにポイッと世界に投げ出されます、ノーヒントでやろうとしたら最初の道具にすらなかなかたどり着けずにずっとマップをウロウロ、
2人マルチでやってたので、「あそこじゃない？これじゃない？」みたいに話しながら初期拠点にたどり着き、
最初はスコップで土を掘ってバケツに入れてタライに移して、水を汲んでブラシで磨いて、出てきた鉱石を売りに言って小銭を稼いで…

インベントリはなく、常に1つのオブジェクトしか手に持てない、
作業や建築は道具や素材を1個ずついちいち持ち替えながら。
お金もオブジェクト扱いなので、荷物が詰める台車や車がないと買い物すら覚束ない。
その代わり、工夫して少しずつ便利になったり、効率化のコツを掴んだりしていくのが凄く楽しい。

プレイしながら「すげー面倒なんだけど、なんかずっとやっちゃうんだよな…」って感想が浮かんできます。

手作業でコツコツやるのもやってる感があって割と楽しいし、
買い物も、商品選んででカートに積んでお会計して車に積んで、みたいな一連の動きがリアル買い物っぽくて嫌いじゃない。
もちろんコンベアと機械で自動化が出来てくるとワクワクするし、必要ないのに家まで建てちゃったりしちゃったり。

負荷について書かれていますが、2人で50時間弱かけて、3箇所の拠点に採掘加工、農場、家など結構建てた状態でもまだ軽快に動いています(Ryzen7 9700F/32G/Geforce4060Ti)
ただ、オートセーブの際に1瞬カクンと固まります、初期は気にならなかったけど発展してきたら若干気になる水準に。
オートセーブは初期設定だと5分間隔ですが、これまでバグやエラー落ちなど一切なかったので自己責任で30分間隔に伸ばしました。

[h2]オンラインマルチプレイを何卒！ [/h2]
個人的には、今の所不満点はマルチプレイの仕様くらい。
ずっと2人マルチでやってますが、Remote Play Togetherでの分割画面マルチしか出来ないのがとても不満です。

設定で画面をデュアルモニタ一杯まで引き伸ばせるようになっているので、うちみたいな家庭内マルチなら1画面ずつ見て遊ぶことも出来るけど、普通の分割画面だと流石に狭くて見づらいしテキストや地図を見るのもしんどい。
何より、Remote Play Togetherだと参加側はゲームパッドしか使えないのが最大の難点に感じます。
オブジェクト操作でシビアな視点操作を要求されるシーンが多く、ゲームパッドでの操作はかなりストレスです。

インタビュー記事などを見ると物理演算の負荷が高く技術的に難しいとのことですが、オンラインマルチプレイの実装は切なる願いです
独立したDedicated Serverを使ったサバクラ型でもいいし、マイクラみたいにチャンク式で負荷分散してなんとか…なんて妄想してみたり

review:
I paid $5 and probably got my money's worth for 2.7h of play time. I have two very large issues that are echoed throughout the negative reviews.

My first is having two different reticles. The middle one is if you are applying one object to another and the one on the right side, on the ground, and out of your sight unless you look down. It's not intuitive so I have to make an effort to remember which it need at any given moment.

My second issue is the reason I stopped playing. Holding one item at a time. If there was an upgrade to allow multiple items to be picked up, then maybe I could continue. I just can't stand the tedium of picking up and dropping items over and over, without even item stacking. The pan idea is cool but not good enough. Need 5 pipes? Pick up you money and go to the store. Pick up 5 pipes individually, put on the buy platform, buy them, now pick up those 5 again (and your money) and head back to your site to pick up and put down those items again. Hope you grabbed a vehicle/cart otherwise it's a separate trip to and from the store for each pipe.

I wanted to like this game but it's too tedious to move objects around. I actually quit when I was enjoying fishing more. Seems odd to enjoy everything in a mining game except the mining.

Nope, not good. It was fun through tier 1, but started to get boring and repetitive by tier 2 and there was too little new content for way too much effort for the fun to stay up. There are also too many things that don't work right for me. I don't like the controls - I think they meant to be “simple” but they make things more complicated and not fluid. The worst thing is that you can only hold and carry one thing in your hands. The workaround is to stack things on pallets and carry the loaded pallet. So the main task is not actually to mine ore, but to stack things artfully on pallets. Artfully because the collision detection and the “funny” physics engine make this task rather unfun. 
That was actually the main reason to abandon the game, because you need so many things to set up your mine factory that it soon drives you mad shopping, stacking on pallets and transporting. The vegetable farming is mediocre, the quests are mediocre, there are no interesting new tasks after going through the Tier 1 playthrough.It remains just running around and transporting things.The logical circuits are not really needed because you earn enough to too much money with the simple upgrade levels.The whole game is a mess.The performance isn't good either, apart from the fact that the graphics are pretty basic.

it's an extremely neat little game. if you like games like factorio or satisfactory then you'll feel right at home here.

99% of this game is just problemsolving or coming up with clever ways of optimizing your mining operation/refining/etc. i've seen a lot of reviews saying that the game is slow - yes, if all you're doing is digging up dirt by hand and cleaning it by hand then you won't get anywhere. as early as an hour-ish in, you can start automating things by routing water closer to you, using water power to hand sort materials, so on and so forth. once you get the hang of it, the money you earn essentially starts skyrocketing.

i've always loved the idea of going deeper underground to source materials, think of games like minecraft, terraria, etc and this game is basically a combination of that with satisfactory's automation. (albeit not as hardcore). the deeper you dig = the better stuff you get. 

the game is very modular in the sense that you can dig any way you like, setup your little underground base any way you like, decorate it, move things around, figure out your own ways of how to get the materials out and back to the surface, etc. there are millions of ways to approach this and the sandbox that you're given compliments it a lot! you're not restricted by anything and yes, you will have to go through some trial & error, but the satisfaction you get after seeing your entirely automated mining operation dig, sort, transport & smelt everything is just pure bliss.

the devs are awesome, too. the game got a lot of good quality updates along side a dlc that added an entire new map, new mechanics, new resources and lots, lots more. all for 10$! that doesn't happen much anymore in gaming, does it?

TL;DR if you like the idea of going deeper & deeper to get more & better quality resources while combining that with automation - you'll love this.

review:
Ao iniciar o jogo, fui imediatamente envolvido pela sua estética e pela promessa de uma jogabilidade envolvente. No entanto, a alegria inicial rapidamente se transformou em frustração ao perceber que o multiplayer, uma característica tão esperada, simplesmente não funciona como deveria. É quase como se o desenvolvedor tivesse decidido que a interação social não era uma prioridade, o que é uma pena, considerando o potencial que o jogo tinha.

É difícil não se sentir decepcionado ao ver um título que poderia ter sido uma experiência memorável se não fosse por essa falha crucial. A falta de um multiplayer funcional não é apenas uma pequena falha; é uma escolha que impacta diretamente a diversão e a longevidade do jogo. É como se o desenvolvedor tivesse esquecido que muitos jogadores buscam a conexão e a competição que um modo multiplayer pode proporcionar.

Entendo que criar um jogo é uma tarefa monumental e que imprevistos podem ocorrer, mas é difícil não questionar as decisões tomadas durante o desenvolvimento. Um pouco mais de atenção a esse aspecto poderia ter transformado uma experiência mediana em algo realmente especial. Espero que, em futuras atualizações ou lançamentos, a equipe de desenvolvimento considere a importância de um multiplayer que funcione adequadamente, pois isso poderia elevar o jogo a um novo patamar.

鉱石掘り自動化ゲーム。

一見カジュアルに見えるが中身は硬派で、説明や誘導はほぼ無い。自分で目的や楽しみを探せる人向け。こういうのが好きなので、ずっともくもくと作業できて楽しい。

Gold Mining Simulator と同じく、手作業で土を掘り水で鉱石を抽出して売る流れからスタートする。そこからはリアルな重機と巨大設備で効率化させるGMSとは違い、Hydroneerでは工業クラフトゲーのような自動化の方向へ進めていく。

どのように機械やラインを組んで自動化させていくかというゲームではある。工業建築だけでなく住居の建築もでき、鉱石掘り以外にも釣りや農業もある。農業でも自動化等考える部分もあり。

クエストはあるものの、それは目的を示すものではなく通貨を獲得するためのおつかいクエでしかない。

本当に説明と誘導が無いので、極端に好みが分かれるはず。好きな人は考えて調べて試行錯誤を繰り返しずっとやれるし、誘導が無いと楽しめない人は初手から何をやっていいか分からず投げてしまうだろう。

この手が好きな人基準で言うと内容はカジュアルで気軽に遊べる。価格もお手頃なので十分オススメできる。

review:
The definition of word janky is

    of extremely poor or unreliable quality.
 
Key word is unreliable in case of Hydroneer. The game is not bad per se, but there is no reason to purchase for full price, I got it for 5 eurobucks on sale and would strongly advise potential buyers to do the same if You HAVE to go for hydroneer and not its better competitors. You dont really need to read the rest of my rant as playtime speaks for itself, just skim number of hours played on people reviewing Factorio or Satisfactory and then compare to Hydroneer, it always is the best indicator of game quality, that people actually play the thing. 

I foolishly did not read the fine print and thought that I will be playing Co-op with a friend, started for few hours without him and played for too long to request a refund when we found out what kind of multiplayer is present in product and rest assured, it is not what we expected, leaving me curious if its worth it continuing alone.

Building and automation are simplistic and clunky. Sound design is a dumpster fire, from unsatisfying machinery sounds to downright infuriating main character HUH and water squeaking sounds that i had to mute 1 hour in, all the way to NPCs talking like in a game made for 5 year olds.

Physics engine is just bad and accomplishing anything takes way longer than it should because the game features no inventory system, player can hold 1 item ranging from every single piece of ore to physical coins as currency. Game does not respect player`s time at any given time, there is nothing meaningful to strive towards once You get setup going, no money sink just purposeless trash to buy and unbelievably some players consider this mind-boggling mess of mechanics ,,gimmicks,,

As a rule of thumb I generally like to read at least few dozens reviews before I post mine, and at first, after few hours of gameplay I was surprised by the amount of positive ones, not really getting it, but the game really clicks after a while and becomes this uncut cocaine of videogame jank. However as with every hard drug, there is a crash back to reality, for some it is a savefile wipe or some other technical issue that should NOT be present after almost six years of development, for me it was accidental subscribe on HML mod in menu, which apparently disabled achievements for the rest of the game, thus making me lose the only motivation I had to keep going.

Last thing that I want to touch upon bad taste I got after reading the dev team communication with playerbase on certain reviews. It certainly is inspiring to see indie team to succeed with their product and see commercial success but there is something distasteful in trying to both present oneself as the underdog indie studio thankful for every purchase and also going ,, sounds like Hydroneer isn’t the game for you, and that’s okay! With Hydroneer our aim is to make a unique gaming experience that isn’t for everyone. ,, My guy, as if there ever was a possibility of this product ever being for ,,everyone,,
and the dev team just not went for it out of principle( I would very much like to hear what games do they think actually are for everyone) . Lets not kid ourselves here, even in 2025 it is a good-ish experience provided everything actually works at any given time, and there certainly is something to be said about morality of giving a pass to feature lacking buggy releases because they are labor of a small team that later updates shell of a product and actually receives praise for commitment years later.

But to end on a positive note I can certainly imagine Hydroneer a safe choice for parents wanting safe experience with just creativity and freedom to do stupid stuff.

Not a building or factory sim, its a clean your room simulator.  You can only hold 1 item at a time, that includes money and/or maps.  Holding an item is done at some weird "in my right hand outside the Field of View" location by default.  A long key press shifts the held item to the center cursor, unless you mess up the long press and drop the item.  The odd handling of objects highlights how un-fun moving every item from the shop, to the purchase platform, to the truck/cart, to the mine is.  Building is much more fun and less monotonous in games like Valheim, Factorio, Satisfactory.

The mine setup is simple and automation effective once setup.  Graphics and art style work well to portray a simple mining village. There is music and sound that you will forget before the game closes to the desktop.

In order to get any automated machines in this automation game you need to haul a large amount of resources to one specific spot on the map, put them in the item chute, go down the elevator, walk to the anvil, buy the design from the shop, put the masterwork design and the materials on the anvil, pull the lever, put the machine in the item chute, walk to and go back up the elevator, load the machine onto your vehicle, and drive back to wherever you've built.

[h1]Pain in the nutsack simulator...[/h1]
Everything in this game is just a pain. It's like if Terarria had a baby with Dark Souls, and then that baby was malnourished and stupid and ugly (plus its breath stank too). The fact that it doesn't have an in-game tutorial is so stupid because you spend 30mintues on it and then lose all your progress after it's completed. Complete waste of time and it's not even voiced and it's one of the laziest tutorials I've ever seen. If the devs put so little effort into the tutorial, then I'm afraid the rest of the game will have the same level of terrible design, and I won't waste my time with it. There's far better games out there than this and I won't let it waste another second of my time.

Weirldy unpolished polished game.
Clunkiness does not translate well to the new take on gameplay, i have no idea what didn't let developers make a proper drag and drop system with items, instead you have to manually aim and drop stuff with a small dot recticle on the ground. 

Nothing is clear, does smelting more than a single ingot increases the mass? Does it just outright destroy excess nuggets? No telling the difference, no visual cues. 

Starting tedium seems to get sorted out the more you play, but game still has a weird lot of stuff that just feels awkward as hell, no idea why everything has to be dropped and not slotted, things seem to fall over and go around the place every time. 

While this game has a bunch of interesting premise, it jsut feels like devs didn't bother implementing general quality of life interactions and just a little bit of fine tuning while working with navigation and clutter management.

hydroneer es un juego que padece de una extrema crisis de identidad, el nucleo del juego es la mineria y en ese sentido hace un gran trabajo con un gran pero que describiré mas adelante, el problema es que pareciera que el juego no sabe que quiere hacer y te introduce dos mecanicas completamente innecesarias: la pesca que no aporta absolutamente nada y la agricultura que esta completamente fuera de lugar y que solo se retroalimenta a si misma sin interactuar con lo demás por lo que es practicamente otro juego en si misma y no ayuda que sea horriblemente tediosa y que su unico objetivo sea llevarle sopa a algunas personas.
Volviendo a la minería, el juego hace un excelente trabajo premiandote por el esfuerzo, empezando con trabajo manual y poco a poco automatizando y expandiendo la produccion y ¿cual es el problema? bueno el problema son los tiers: hay 3 tiers de maquinas y 3 tiers de suelos y ¿cual es la diferencia entre ellos? tecnicamente hablando absolutamente ninguna, los tiers te permiten producir mas rapido que el anterior, eso es todo, en tier 2 empiezas a sacar corestone que solo te sirve para construir maquinas tier 3 y que no es exclusivo de ese tier pues con la pala puedes obtener ese mineral y ese es precisamente el problema, una vez automatizas tier 1 no hay ninguna razon para seguir con los siguientes tiers, es simplemente repetir lo mismo solo para ver numeros mas grandes en las ventas y tal vez para desbloquear el paso hasta el rey pero ¿para que quieres hacer eso? 
La construccion es genial, pero eso de tener que llevar pieza por pieza es un dolor de cabeza, se que es parte del encanto del juego pero me hubiese gustado que tuviera un inventario.
La conduccion tiene muchos problemas, tu vehiculo se vuelca o se buggea constantemente y puede subir paredes verticales, las carreteras son practicamente un adorno.
Lo recomiendo, pero no seria mi prioridad habiendo otros juegos con premisas similares

나름 먹을만한 광질 자동화 똥겜

이제는 꽤나 흔한 장르의 게임이다. 땅을 파서 돈이되는 광물을 찾고 크래프팅으로 돈을 벌고 번 돈을 통해서 광질을 자동화하는 공정을 만드는 게임. 이런 자동화 크래프팅 분야에 갓겜도 많지만 이 게임은 게임의 핵심적인 부분은 나름 잘 갖춰져있지만 나머지가 전부 똥겜이다.

중독성 있는 광질과 직관적인 자동화는 매력적인 부분이다. 특히나 땅의 깊이나 수압 그리고 수질등의 요소들이 단순했던 게임을 나름 흥미롭게 만들어준다. 
깊은 땅에서 드릴을 박아야 효율적이라는 말에 물을 끌어와서 깊은 땅속에서 배관과 기계를 어떻게 하면 효율적으로 작은 공간에 넣을 수 있을지를 고민하게 만든다.
수압 시스템으로 최단거리의 배관을 짜도록 유도하는 점도 흥미롭고 수질시스템으로 논리회로를 이용한 자동화로 유도하는 점도 재미가 있었다.

자동화 마이닝 게임의 핵심적인 부분들은 꽤나 흥미롭고 재밌게 할 수 있는 게임이지만, 그 이외의 것들은 죄다 똥겜이다.
인벤토리나 지갑이라는 개념이 없어서 일일히 손으로 들고 옮기거나 바구니에 살살 넣어야 하는 점은 나름의 현실성 내지 게임의 개성이라고 봐줄 수는 있다.
하지만, 물건을 내려놓는 에임이 거지같고 물건을 살포시 내려놓는 방법이 전무하고 모든 아이템을 손수 옮기고 내려놓아야 하는 게임이면서 캐릭터는 모든 물건을 내려놓을때 거의 던지다시피 내려놓는 조작감이 매우 거지같다.
게임의 초반구간에는 많은 아이템을 요구하지 않고 수레나 바구니 등을 이용하면 되지만, 게임이 진행되면 될수록 큰 시설을 만들게되고 더 깊은 지역으로 이동하고자하면 이겜의 똥겜스러움이 더욱 부각된다. 
배관이나 물건을 배치하기 위해서도 일일히 하나씩 상점에서 내가 손으로 내 차량에 상하차를 진행해야하고 이를 도와주는 도구로 있는 파레트는 차량 트렁크랑 달리 물리엔진이 고스란히 적용되서 파레트에 물건을 담다가 질질 흘리면 정신이 나간다.
넓은 지역을 쉽게 평탄화나 채굴을 하기위해서 있는 중장비는 조작감과 속도가 상당히 안 좋다.
손수 한 삽 한 삽 파다가 거대한 자동화 광산을 만드는 것이 이 게임이 표방하는 방향으로 보이지만, 거대한 자동화 광산을 만드는 과정도 한 개 한 개 손으로 옮겨가며 만들어야 한다는 점이 생각보다 피로감을 유발한다.

다소 쌩뚱맞게 있다고 느낌이 드는 농장 시스템은 대놓고 메인퀘스트 완료까지의 플레이타임을 늘리겠다는 의지가 팍팍 느껴지는 시스템이라 꽤나 불쾌한 컨텐츠였다. 
배관을 이용해서 물주기를 자동화 하지 않으면 농작물을 하나 키우는데 과하게 많은 시간을 요구한다는 점에서 어느정도 마이닝 자동화로 재화가 충분할 때 진입하는 컨텐츠라고 생각이 든다.
자동화를 표방하는 게임임에도 마이닝에 비해서 농장의 자동화가 농장 퀘스트로만 얻을 수 있는 재화로만 구성할 수 있고 그 비용이 꽤 높다는 점에서 마이닝에서 노가다에서 자동화로 벽을 겨우겨우 넘은 플레이어를 다시 농장 노가다의 구렁텅이로 던지는 것 같다. 노가다를 하려고해도 농장 특유의 성장시간 때문에 플레이타임을 꽤나 잡아먹는 컨텐츠이다.

다분히 똥겜의 요소가 많지만, 노가다 요소나 자동화 초반부의 재미는 다른 공장게임의 재미에 크게 뒤지지는 않는다.
이런 장르의 게임을 좋아하는 친구라도 먼저 선뜻 추천을 하진 않겠지만, 친구가 이 게임을 어딘가에서 알아서 한 번 해보려고 할 때 굳이 말리지는 않을 정도의 게임

There's an old gaming meme that basically goes: "In the green box, you'll find a fun game. In the red box, you'll find a challenging game. If you play the game in the blue box, days will blur together, regular meals will become a thing of the past, your friends will become concerned, and the whole time you'll be unsure if you're even having fun."

Hydroneer is the bluest blue game that ever blued a blue game.

An example will be illustrative.

In House Flipper, to lay a concrete floor, you draw a box in the ground where you want the floor to be, you click on each square in the box, and you have a concrete floor. The whole process takes maybe 30 seconds.

In Valheim, to lay a stone floor, you plant a stone-cutter, put a bunch of stone in your inventory, equip the build tool, and one by one place the stone blocks in the arrangement of a floor, clicking each location. The whole process takes maybe two or three minutes if you have the stone in inventory.

In Hydroneer, to lay a concrete floor, you have to (VERY long breath) grab your stockpile of coins, drive your truck to town, put your coins into a little bucket, carry stone blocks one by one inside the store to the cash register, buy the stone blocks, transfer the blocks one by one to your truck bed, pick up your coins, put those in your truck, drive the truck back to base, pick up the stone blocks one by one and carry them to where you want the stone floor, precisely click the location where you want THAT block, go back to your truck for the next stone block, and place each block one by one until they're all placed. The whole process can take upwards of 30 minutes depending on the size of the floor.

At this point, you either know exactly what kind of game Hydroneer is, have stopped reading this review, and bought a copy, or you are recoiling from your monitor in horror. Either way, you now know everything you need to know about Hydroneer, because every process in the game works like this. The game is called Hydroneer for a reason, and that reason is that you will individually buy approximately 500 pipe pieces to reach the mid-game and lay them one by one.

And yet... and yet... and yet. I would be lying if I didn't say there is tremendous satisfaction in getting the systems in Hydroneer to do what you want. It's incredibly satisfying to watch a large mid-game base operate that extends deep underground after you've done all the exploring, tunneling, architecting, and building to make it work.

Is it fun? Still can't say. But I do recommend it. 8/10.

I  wanted to like this. I picked it up in early access years ago, and decided it needed a lot of work. Then I tried it again now that it is final release. It just gets too tedious too fast.

They made a kind of unique means of interacting with the world, and it's kind of quaint at first, but gets irritating very fast. The reason that most successful games use similar control methods, is that they are intuitive and easy to use. 

Here you have no inventory and can only pick up one thing at a time. I guess the character is one armed and backpacks have not been invented.... You also can't put it down or place it normally, but can only drop things from about 4 ft high. There is a little dot where it will fall, and you need to go into the settings and change it's color or it's very hard to see sometimes. Many things, especially the crucible, will not just fall and stay put, but will roll and often stay on their side. But if you need to drop things into them, like the crucible, then you have to pick it up and drop it again, and again, and again, until it lands right. Very stupid not to just set the dang thing down.

You press the E key to pick things up. Be that an item that you made on the anvil, or the anvil it's self that was a place-able object. This means that when you miss slightly in picking up a small ring you just made, you instead pick up the whole anvil and then have to reorient and place it again. 

You don't fill a pan with water by holding the pan and clicking on the stream which would make logical game sense. No, you have to drop the pan in the stream and then pick it up again. This gets old fast. It actually reminds me a bit of those humorous surgery simulator games where you can't control your hands well and you end up spattering guts everywhere. But this is not meant to be humorous. 

I could give a lot more examples, but this very quickly becomes irritating to play and I stopped. There aree also no real goals, and tools and parts are not explained well. You have to drive a long way to get to stores that sell more then basic parts, and that's boring. There is a food and crop system, that I was not at all motivated to try after briefly trying fishing and getting bored. There are occasional people that if you approach them they say they want something. It's a specific item with a specific weight of metal, but there is no way of seeing how much metal you have before making that part, so how are you supposed to do that?? Maybe there is a way, but it's not explained in the brief tutorial or anywhere else that I saw.

In the end I just got bored and irritated and stopped. I think this could be a good game if it was made differently, with huge QOL improvements, a story, goals and better guides. But it looks like it was finished a while ago.

on the one hand its insane and tedious, you have to pick items up individually, load them one by one, loading a vehicle in hydroneer with your machines can sometimes feel almost realistic in time spent wrangling things in your truck...

the start of the game is a slog tbh, its maybe a few hours before the game actually progresses into automation. you wont really be able to get a true feel for the game in the 2hr refund window, but it will give you at least a bit of a feel i suppose!

you start on your plot of land, large bucket, smol bucket, shovel, map and lamp...

the best way to start is, shovel dig dirt, palce dirt in river, do this ten times, then shovel dig dirt from river into large bucket, (keep this bucket submerged)
bring brush over and scrub dirt, it really is that tedious in the begginning lol! scoop, swirl, scoop swirl... when you do this ten times you can sell your ores at a nearby vendor just at the top of the hill. (take your bucket full of resources and sprint up the hill, or take your trusty cart and make your way up there slowly)

find a nearby shop and buy a fishing rod, now you can continue on with scrub, scoop, scrub.. or you can play the fishing minigame, theres multiple fish to catch, and i think like 8 rods total in game... make sure you stand near the large bucket with the circle thingy in the bucket.
now you are fishing for moneys...
later on you can even go fishing while your machines collect precious ores for you, or perhaps even find ways to automate fishing too...
also don't forget to check out steam discussions if you are lost, plenty of wonderful tutorials out there. but for your first automation you will want to aim for the two machines sold in the nearby shop, hook them up to your renewable water source, and set them up so dirt falls into crusher... then after a while you will want to purchase a spanner, a crucible/furnace thingy, etc...
and then you will make bars of gold/iron and sell these. (don't forget to take advantage of the stock market!)
finally after maybe a few hours you will be able to travel out to the further shops in bridgepour (check your map) and find conveyors, and whatnot to create an actual fully automated mine/smelter operation, and from there on its up to you! 

i have to say despite this games initial tedium its really fun/addictive. and the way it handles inventory management (you have no inventory, every item is placed in your hand), its up to you to decide whether you can run with a bucket, need a cart, or maybe even your hydro powered tractor to complete a task, is pretty interesting and honestly works well here, not many games that mechanic works with, but it really works well here imo!
seeing your coins stack up into piles after amassing 5k and whatnot is honestly pretty satisfying! 
i think if you like grindy games, or automation games you may like this one, but ill stress that automation fans may find this title tedious compared to what you are used to! its more of a mining game (now with crops/planting) 
there's also some really crazy logic contraptions for the smarter crazier people. you could certainly make a counting machine, and whatnot... or you could just use it to automate crop watering for example...

this game goes deep, and doesn't really explain much to you tbh, you have to explore alot, tho each item does at least tell you what it does/how to use in brief, so that's nice!

not many games handle the whole voxel digging thing often, but ill admit after playing a game about digging a hole i had the itch to dig more holes, so came back! honestly im surprised at how far this game has come over its years! 
there's tons of easter eggs based within the community here, including one aimed at letsgameitout's josh... (iykyk, if not check out his yt series on hydroneer if you want some laughs!)

So why the negative review?
Because I'm not hooked.

You get dropped in the game and after a few hours that was it. I didn't want to play it anymore.
There is no 'goal', no idea that I want to see come to life in this game world.

With other games I have goals to reach, to progress or just to build cool stuff.
Here it's missing. In the volcalidus expansion, therethere is actual quests and a goal of sorts (rebuild the glade)
But the quests to make you go around the island are all just copy-pasted (move this box to the next NPC)
Why not move actual items they need (fuel, mining equipment, ...) no... here we copy paste the exact quest, just move the destination a bit and leave any storytelling or immersion behind.
I would have expected the handholding in the main game, not the addon.

I shoveled dirt, I made machines run on water
The hole is a few meters deep, the rest of the quarry is untouched.
I progressed to fishing rod tier IV, the fishing sucks because the timing is the same all the time and you can't 'lose' a fish.
I poured a 200.15 bar and made it into a dagger for a quest, the NPC in the castle rejected it because it is 0.15 over.
Buckets full of ore getting spilled when you pour them into a funnel above a smelter and having to pick them up one by one... The magnet stick just nudges them slightly, can't use it to collect it and throw it back in a bucket.

Don't tell me this game is for specific people... I played other games like DF, planetcrafter, satisfactory, deep rock galactic.... I strip mined entire mountains because I could or built excessive powergeneration because I wanted the factory to grow.

They advise you to play the game NOT on sandbox, but the game behaves like a sandbox since there is no story nor are there goals.
What goals can you set yourself if you need to first drive to the main city just to see what other things there are to work with?

Here you are hindered by the one item at a time you need to carry around.
The first thing you do ingame is go to settings and change the drop off point to some other color than the standard one, because it will drive you crazy.
The thought of having to go fetch the stack of coins, haul that around and handpick every single item you think you need, haul it back and come to the conclusion that forgetting a single 90 bend is not worth continuing the playtrough is kinda what made me write this out.
It's an OK game, but for me it is missing the fun part.

Gameplay is appealing to me: casual, no combat, just build/mine/sell stuff... for a pseudo-puzzle feel.

The only thing I can really say I dislike is the token wall limiting T3 corestone pipes currently. You need tokens for T3 pipes that you cannot craft currently. Questing is a great expansion to the game, but in a game this open-world, it would be nice to just be able to craft or buy materials instead of chasing NPC's around for half a bowl of tomato soup that buys you 1/10 of a pipe.

Have you ever wanted to do some mining and crafting with one hand tied behind your back?

Lovely graphics, and runs decently on my laptop in potato mode.  But, and I cannot stress this enough, there's no personal inventory.  You can hold exactly one item at a time -- including all resources and crafted items, including all tools, including money, including your map, including your light source, and even including *quests* which take the form of a scroll.  You can pickup/drop items with the e key, and use them with a mouseclick -- and the default mapping for controllers feels worse, imo.  

Minor caveats:  Some objects will fit inside buckets, and can be carried in them (after you painstakingly put them all into the bucket one at a time by hand), and the contents of buckets can be dumped out.  You can also put even very large items into your giant two-wheeled cart, but you move very slow while dragging it and have the turn radius of a large boat.  Thankfully,  items in containers or your one single hand are immune to physics, so you don't have to worry about accidentally flinging them into space like in some VR games.

My early-game gameplay loop looks like this:  Pick up your shovel, put four scoops of dirt into your bucket, drop your shovel, grab the bucket, dump the bucket into the pan, drop the bucket, grab the brush, brush the pan, drop the brush, grab the pan, dump the pan into the cart, drop the pan in the water, repeat.  After around 10 times of this, you can either go sell raw ore, or process it if you have the tools to do so.  And hope you dropped all of your items in the right positions so you can find them again later.

There seems to be automation later on, but you do not start with any.

There's some purely-decorative player customization, but it's very limited, with 3 male faces and 1 female.  I would be absolutely Thrilled if they added the ability to make your character look one-armed -- or, an inventory hotbar.  Or a starting backpack.  Or if there was an inventory hotbar mod, which I don't think I see one of.  Or a single off-hand equipment slot...

It doesn't seem like a very deep game, but it does look pleasant.  The destructable and reconstructable terrain is interestingly done and seems pretty competent, the prices vary by day so there's some merchant-genre game systems in play, and a fishing system.  If you find methodical repetition soothing, maybe this is a good game for that.  It's priced a little higher than I personally would prefer, but I got it on sale and am pretty happy with that.  I've run into a few minor bugs with being able to place furniture underground inside terrain, or the tutorial not explaining how to rotate furnishings (the r key), but nothing gamebreaking.  There is an "unstuck" button in the pause screen, which I was amused to discover respawns you in a graveyard.

You probably know whether it sounds tempting or not, by this far into the review.  Consider it if your stable of mining-and-crafting experiences is running low.

I give this a light recommendation when on sale. 

The core of the game is solid, but there are many annoying and tedious things that bring it down, along with a lack of an endgame or final goals. To put it simply, there is a very simple "best way" to make a mine and there's not much else to do besides that. Or actually, when we asked for more (relevant) content, we got farming. So yeah, you can farm tomatoes. But once you build that mine, there's nothing else to do but copy it.

More specifically, we've also asked for better ways to buy/transport/build things because there's no inventory or storage system. Every item has to be manually carried by hand, and besides the huge issue with lag when a truck is full of pipes or other cargo.... you still have to move 1 item at a time onto a truck, then drive it home, then unload 1 item at a time, place all the items in a lag pile, etc. Even the idea of having crates which hold 10+ copies of an item were ignored. Lame.

There's also just little variety in what you produce. The whole idea of the game is to mine and process resources into stuff, but just making iron or gold bars feels like the most basic option possible. The stuff you can do in the first hour or 2 of the game, is the stuff you can do at the very end of the game with 1 exception. 

More than anything, it feels like there's a whole world of potential machines, crafting processes, ingredients, and produced products that isn't being tapped into. And because there's no goal, no endgame item/process/machine to work towards, all we have to play with/for is the production itself, which wouldn't be so bad if there was more to produce and more to manage. 

I bought it and later the dlc when it relased, hoping hydroneer would develop beyond what is, basically, a roblox tycoon game. Maybe this sounds harsh, but i've been around it for a couple years now and this is my honest opinion. It's not a bad game, just a simple one that's small, with little content, and a short gameplay loop. Maybe its perfect for some people, for me its a just a tease.

TLDR: Soft recommend if on sale, or if you want a really simple and straight forward tycoon style game

Summary: Hydroneer is fun, but it has serious technical issues and design flaws. My verdict: 5/10

Pros:
- unique gameplay: mixture of automation, quests and sandbox
- automation is not so complex like e.g. in Satisfactory, for automation beginners this is ideal, for experienced players this can be too trivial
- sandbox, you can do what you want: you can change the terrain, you can build a house or production line, you can fulfill quests, you can also do stupid things, if you want (there are some hilarious videos on YT by „Let‘s game it out“).
- I like the freedom Hydroneer offers in the gameplay.

Cons:
The biggest con is, that there is no inventory in the game, neither for the player, nor for the machines. This has impact on the gameplay and also on the technical performance of the game.
- Examples: you want to buy something, then you have to carry money in your hands to the shop, pay for the goods, then you have to carry back your money and your goods, one by one. This is extremely tedious. My recommendation: use the truck as deposit for money, the map, tools and goods.
- The machines also don‘t have an inventory. Everything your machines produce either lands on the ground or preferably in a container. The problem is: the game physics calculate every piece of ore etc. individually, even if the product is in a container. This has huge impact on the game performance. In the beginning when you have not got much stuff the game runs smoothly, but as soon as you produce or store more stuff, the pc starts getting hot, the framerate drops, the game starts lagging, it can even freeze. Example: i had 200 weight in a pan (that means appr. 300 ore), when i poured the contents into another container the game froze and did not respond anymore. After 20 seconds the game was done calculating everything and unfroze on its own. Something like this should not happen, it may be acceptable in Early Access but not for a full release. Optimisation is missing here! For comparison: in Satisfactory you can have hundreds of machines and conveyor belts, you can produce and transport thousands of units per second and still the performance remains good (the devs did a lot of optimisation there).
- In Hydroneer there are no blueprints: you have to build everything piece by piece. Every single pipe or cable etc has to be bought in the shop and transported back to the construction site. This is extremely time consuming and boring. In Satisfactory you can use the blueprinter and can pop down a new production with one click.

My conclusion: have fun in Hydroneer, do some stupid stuff or whatever entertains you, but i would not try to play this game as a serious automation game. There are several other automation games in the Steam shop that are far better in this respect.

Эту игру, безусловно, стоит пересмотреть. Игра была выполнена на высоком уровне, однако, возможно, кому-то не понравится, как она получилась. Игра Hydroneer не для слабонервных или ленивых. Странным образом (с точки зрения времени) каждый ход, который делает игрок, требует тщательного планирования. Если вы из тех, кто любит бегать взад-вперед между боксами, возможно, это не для вас. Если вы ищете что-то более тяжелое с точки зрения реалистичности крафта (в том, что касается транспортировки материалов) - это может быть для вас! Игроки должны быть предупреждены, что обучение очень быстрое и приятное, и игра не любит, когда игроков держат за руки по какой-либо причине. Физика этой игры - одна из самых обсуждаемых тем, как хороших, так и плохих.

Игровой процесс Hydroneer основан на креативной схеме, в которой игроки творчески используют воду. Игроки находят способы наиболее эффективного сбора ресурсов, выкапывая их из земли, чтобы продавать их, получать прибыль и в дальнейшем создавать более сложные творения. В игре есть автоматизация, которая может упростить процессы для игрока. Игроку доступны ленты, плавильни, дробилки и целый ряд других опций. Сложность заключается в том, чтобы собрать все это воедино, особенно когда для функционирования каждой детали (включая конвейерные ленты) требуется вода! Самое большое отличие геймплея в Hydroneer (которого я не видел ни в одной другой игре) заключается в том, что персонаж игрока может одновременно держать только один предмет. Да, верно, игрок может держать только один предмет за раз. Это означает, что каждый собранный предмет нужно собирать один за другим вручную. Это также означает, что если игрок неправильно разместит ведро или насыплет руду на печь, то эти предметы также придется собирать по одному. По сути, эта система одновременно прекрасна и уродлива. Это то, что отличает эту игру от множества других игр для крафта, в которых предусмотрен инвентарь. Каждый ход рассчитывается так, что если игрок что-то забудет (например, тележку), это может свести его с ума. Даже когда что-то куплено, деньги и предмет нельзя унести одновременно. Мне понравился этот аспект игры, потому что он напомнил мне о рабочих профессиях: не совершай больше поездок, чем нужно. Та же идея применима здесь и сейчас, и, как бы ни была неприятна эта концепция игрокам, она, безусловно, является глотком свежего воздуха, потому что требует от игрока постоянного внимания и вовлеченности, а не бездумной возможности быстро восстановиться благодаря дополнительному пространству для хранения. Строить очень просто. Что потенциально может свести игроков с ума, так это случайный подбор мебели / инструментов, а не руды или добытых материалов. К счастью, мебель / инструменты легко вернуть на место. В деревне есть приличное количество магазинов, которые можно посетить, и в деревне легко ориентироваться. Игроку доступны транспортные средства, облегчающие транспортировку припасов. Игроку придется загружать их вручную, поштучно, даже с помощью транспортных средств. Транспортные средства действительно значительно облегчают жизнь в Hydroneer!

Визуальные эффекты и графика хорошо вписываются в окружающую среду. Графика напоминает Fortnight, но имеет немного более плавные детали и округлую графику. Все основные и необходимые анимации включены и видны. Машины перемещаются, и игрок может видеть, как материалы проходят через машины, конвейеры или попадают в дробилки. На некоторых машинах выход довольно забавный, так как они выходят с другой стороны, и игрок должен быть наготове с ковшом на другой стороне, чтобы поймать материал. Графика местности снова гладкая и не содержит слишком много деталей, но это никоим образом не мешает игре. Деревенская атмосфера была хорошо проработана, и в игре присутствует смена дня и ночи. Звуки и музыка в основном спокойные. В музыкальном оформлении нет ничего необычного, и, хотя оно хорошо подходит для игры, не ожидайте, что кто-то ударит по голове. Было добавлено много звуков, которые улучшают впечатления от игры. Все, с чем взаимодействует игрок, будет издавать какой-то шум и оповещать игрока звуком о том, что действие завершено. Обе области были выполнены хорошо, но я чувствую, что можно было бы добавить немного больше, чтобы еще больше погрузить игрока в игру. Здесь упущен некоторый потенциал, поскольку можно было бы сделать немного больше с атмосферными звуками. Деревню приятно исследовать и осматриваться по сторонам, немного больше шума сделало бы ее более оживленной. NPC, которые ходят вокруг и занимаются своими делами, в некотором роде помогают.

В целом, игра мне понравилась, но я вижу, что многие люди интересуются: "Что за флипперы, холодильник, пожарную машину, вилку для пердежа я только что купил?". Моей первой реакцией был небольшой шок, когда я узнал, что персонаж может носить только одну вещь за раз, но после того, как я немного изучил игру, лучше спланировал свои действия и обнаружил на карте немного больше полезных инструментов, я был увлечен. Игра (и, следует сказать, разработчик) гордится тем, что ей не приходится держать игрока за руку. Помимо руководства, в игре предлагается не так уж много помощи, побуждающей игрока самостоятельно исследовать мир и узнать, что возможно. Так что, это приложение сложно просматривать. В нем есть разделенный экран для локальной игры и многопользовательская онлайн-игра, если один игрок использует функцию удаленной игры Steam. Настоятельно рекомендую игрокам сделать домашнюю работу перед покупкой, но, безусловно, рекомендую покупать на распродаже. ОДНАКО ХОЧУ ПРЕДУПРЕДИТЬ - даже для себя - логическая система содержит минимум инструкций, и с ней может быть очень сложно работать, если вы не разбираетесь в базовом программировании.

I really want to be able to enjoy this game but everything in it is designed to be as painful and slow to do as possible. 

I bought the drilling machine to be able to make a nice mine area underground, After struggling for 4 hours to dig a simple ramp down and flatten an area out I've given up. I tried to tidy up the floor with large concrete blocks and provide a flat surface for the drill to use as a basis, but as soon as i start tunnelling it veers downwards and ends up digging lower and creating a new level. 

So I could just nuke the area and build a floor out of concrete, right? No..because you can only buy 3 or 4 large concrete slabs at a time by dragging them one by one to the buy area. And then after purchasing you lift them one by one into the truck. Repeat 5 or so times and I have the 16 slabs I placed in my mine so far...except those 16 slabs barely cover any floor so Im going to need to stand there for an hour just purchasing blocks!

It's a shame that the game works against itself because it feels like it could be a really enjoyable game if it weren't for these stupid contrived features that make what should be a simple non issue a major problem taking hours to get around.

Edit: I installed some mods to get around the jank and make progress. Turns out this disables achievements...but there's a way to re-enable them once you remove mods by editing the save files.
So im continuing for now, but still would not recommend a game that requires mods to play in any sort of decent way.

20時間ほどプレイした感想になります。工業シム系のゲームは好きな方で他ゲームでは1000時間以上プレイしたゲームもあります。
手動作業から資源、資材を増やし自動化ラインを作成していく要素などは楽しく、面白いゲームだとは思うのですが不快な点があまりにも多く非常に惜しいゲームだったのレビューさせて頂きます。

・操作感が悪い
通常のレティクルとは別にアイテムを落とすドロップポイントがあり、それが中心と大きくズレているため自身が置きたい場所にアイテムが置けないことが多いです。更に落としたアイテムが想像とは異なる場所に跳ねたり、転がったりで…。
ドロップポイントは色を変えることで見やすくはなりますが…それでもプレイ中にはずっと違和感を感じながらも置きたい場所・入れたい場所から転がり落ちるアイテムに発狂します。

・インベントリがない
このゲームにはインベントリがありません。ゆくゆく増えるということもないです。
その代わりに台車やトラック等アイテムを複数載せることが出来る乗り物があるのですが…これらにアイテムを乗せる作業が非常に面倒です。
インベントリが無い為一つ一つ台車に載せないと駄目なのですが、載せるモノによっては綺麗に載らず転がり落ちて発狂します。
やっとの思いでアイテムを台車に載せ終わり、台車をトラックに積み込むのですがそのトラックに台車を載せるのも少しずれるだけで上手く載せることができないのでまた発狂します。
また、ティアが上がり新たな自動ラインを構築する時やラインの流れが気に食わない時は、一度解体して全てのアイテムをまた一から配置し直さないと駄目なのですが…これがインベントリがないという状況と全く噛み合っていません。
最初期段階ではラインも小規模なので耐えられるのですが、少しでも進んでしまうとアイテムを一つづつ解体すると全て莫大な時間がかかる上に、アイテム-台車間で視点を何度も動かすため画面酔いもするレベルです。
これは自動ラインの微調整でも致命的に不快な点なっています。
例えば２つのパイプの向きが合わず自動ラインが上手く動かない場合
自動ラインの問題点に視点を移動→ラインからパイプを取り外すために一度手に取る→手に取ったパイプを放すために振り返ってから空いているスペースに設置・或いは手から落とす→もう一度ラインに視点を移し、手に取ってからパイプの向きを変更する
…と、言った具合に無駄な作業を強いられてしまいます。
これが複数箇所あると振り返って手に持っているアイテムを素早く置く時、既にアイテムが置かれているために指定の場所に置けずキャラクターがうめき声を上げるのでその声に苛ついて発狂します。

他にも不快な点はありますが大きなところだと上記の通りです。
初期段階で不便を楽しむのは理解できますが、自動化がある程度進んでも想定とは異なる場所でこのゲームは不便でした。
自動ライン構築を楽しみにしていたのに、まさか台車から転がり落ちるアイテムを素早く拾いバランスよく慎重に載せるけど失敗してまた転がり落ちるアイテムをまた素早く拾う作業…を永遠とやらされるとは思っていませんでした。
ゲーム自体の要素は楽しいのですが、自動ライン構築を楽しむ工業シムと思ってプレイを始めると非常に苦行ですのでそういったプレイをしたい方にはオススメ出来ません。
本当に惜しい…。

I really want to like Hydroneer. The mining and building aspects were fun enough to keep me tinkering for 100+ hours, but at the end of the day, the thing that stands out to me is how absurdly TEDIOUS the game is. It very deliberately goes out of its way to make doing everything as cumbersome and time-consuming as possible—and it never gets better. There are no quality-of-life improvements. You can't buy a normal map. You can't unlock the ability to bulk-order parts. You can't get a truck that won't bug out and launch your items into orbit. You can't get a wallet or store your money in a bank. You get nothing. You lose. Good day, sir.

Speaking of getting nothing: I suspect the tedium is intended to distract from how little there is to actually do. Once you slap down a miner and smelter and bang out a few swords, you've seen pretty much everything the game has to offer. Sure, you can scale up and build bigger and bigger mines, but there's nothing mechanically different between your starter setup and a giant tier 4 mine. With sandbox games like this, the process itself is supposed to be the reward, but Hydroneer doesn't have any meaningful progression (tech trees, new equipment, new resources, new items to produce, new reasons to produce them, etc.) to keep things interesting and justify the tedium.

及格水平的游戏，但并不推荐别人玩。游戏内容简而言之就是开始使用刷子铲子水桶手动淘金，2个小时以后使用自动化机械搭建流水线淘金。游戏的问题在于没有任何特色，所有方面都是不烂但也没多好，被同类型游戏里各种有独自特色的完爆了。
游戏自动化内容完全没有深度，没有任何设计得可能性，就是把机械排排站，偏偏这还是游戏的核心玩法；
游戏内资源种类非常匮乏，开局就能挖到所有种类的资源，意味着游戏开局就是所见即所得，后续游玩缺少新内容解锁的正反馈，这也是导致自动化内容没有深度的元凶；
游戏数值设计不合理，开局两小时之后就是无限金钱，所有地和机械都随便买，只需要用最低级的自动化设备就能产出根本花不完的金钱；
游戏科技树单薄，随着进度推进唯一能解锁的科技就是效率更高的钻头、洗矿机等初始设备，没有任何新机器类型的加入，配合上金钱获得过于容易，让玩家更换新科技的欲望非常低，但这又偏偏是你唯一能做的事情；
其他系统赶工明显，比如游戏里有种菜和钓鱼，但完全就是半成品水平，没有可展开的完整系统，加上钓鱼就是用极低的出货率硬消磨玩家时间，种菜更是不知道意义在哪；
游戏最大的问题是载具设计和物品购买系统，明显就是硬拖玩家时间的拙略技巧。游戏里所有机械都不小，必须从指定地点购买并由玩家搬运到自己的地里，玩家唯一的搬运手段就是一个非常小的卡车。偏偏卖设备的地方和玩家的地距离还很远，经常从地图两端来回跑。而所有购买的机器都有碰撞体积，连最基础的水管，传送带都贼占地。这就导致游戏很多时间都花在来回搬东西这个愚蠢的事情上，想更新一下生产线？先来回搬个十几趟货吧。想出这个系统的人真的是赤石大王。最逆天的是后期的高级器械是要在一个地下遗迹里铸造的，玩家跑上跑下真的是痛苦至极，上下来回搬材料，搬模具，搬成品。
总而言之，这是一个有着好点子但预算有限的半成品，系统设计的不合理加上没有任何正反馈和新内容解锁让游玩体验很糟糕

Games need some serious bare minimum quality of life content. 
-You do not have an inventory, but the only place you can put stuff is either in buckets, pans, or on the ground.
-Despite the ground being your home for all of your items, there are plenty of places where your items will clip through the ground so you cannot see them. 
-Money very quickly becomes an awkward pile instead of a stack, making it tedious to move around.
-Desirable game functions like being able to see the durability of equipment or making sure you can't move equipment is locked behind tools you have to purchase.
-The cart.
-You don't even have pockets in this game; I can only imagine your character runs around naked.
-Your character cannot step over any sort of dirt and easily becomes stuck.
-Basically there is so many ways for this game to generate headaches, but it lacks the ability to grant any sort of relief.

I still think there is hope for this game, but I'd like to see some additions or changes.
-Just give the player some pockets, even a hotbar of two slots would be fantastic. If that's not "ok" than maybe even a bandolier that lets you hold even one tool. 
-A way to just build furniture from the get go would be nice.
-A poster board to place quest on.
-A table that you can look at and attach items to the surface of. Either for tools, money, etc. 
-Just let me rotate the cart more quickly, this game isn't immersive enough to make that tolerable.
-Just let me shovel dirt into machines with a shovel instead of having to do it with a bucket first. 
-Just remove the grid placement system; free placement is so much better.
-I'd rather have the movement ability of a mountain goat than a dung beetle in a game where your starting pickaxe can only move a shoes worth of dirt and doesn't let you make nice stairs. 
-ALWAYS make the icon that shows where you're going to drop an item visible. Picking something up sixteen times is not fun in the slightest. 

That's all I have for now. I do not plan on updating or deleting this comment if any of these pleas are added or gripes are changed. So beware.

色々不便という斬新なデザインのゲームだと思う。
皆さんのレビューにある通り、インベントリという概念が無く、アイテムの持ち運びすら工夫が必要。なんなら最初はアイテムを入れ物に入れるのですら難しい。チュートリアルも最低限すら無いレベルで操作方法はキーコンフィグで確認したり、自動化の要であるロジック回路も分かればめちゃくちゃ単純なんだけど説明が少ない。そしてどれだけ理解が進もうと、整地作業はかなりの労力となる。他のゲームのようにクリック連打でワンブロックきれいに掘れたりなんてしない。ツルハシを手に持って数度クリックし、ある程度ブロックを削ったら熊手で表面を平らに成型して場合によってはシャベルで掘り過ぎた分を埋め戻し、更に床材をセットして更に床材の表面の土を削って・・と。１０ブロック地下に降りる階段を作るだけでも大仕事である。
釣りは運ゲーにもほどがあるし、農業はこんなに不便に感じていた採掘が天国に思えるほどの大変さ。

もう面倒と隣り合わせどころか同居しているゲームである。
しかし人をはねるのがやたら楽しかったり、島の経済に闇を感じたり、住人がオッサンだらけだったり・・・不便なだけあって自動化の達成感が大きかったり、本気を出せば釣りや農業も結構な部分が自動化可能となる。ただ、自動化を達成できた頃には自動化する意味というか目的が無くなっている。
私もすべてを味わい尽くしてはいないけど、これ以上やる意味ねーよな？って思うところまで来てしまって、急激にモチベーションが下がったが、ここまでの時間はめちゃくちゃ楽しかった。

書いていて、なんでこんなクソ面倒なゲームにはまったのか自分でも理解できない。言葉では言い表せない魅力がある。間違いなく人を選ぶ。面倒な作業が苦痛でなく、神経質で完璧主義者でこういうジャンルが好きな人ならきっとハマるんじゃないだろうか？
